title: Nordle media catalog
description: What each photo or clip actually shows, written after looking at it. The caption-matches-the-picture check is only as good as this. Lives at <project>/assets/catalog.json (clips: <project>/sources/catalog.json).

items.description: Keyed by the project-relative path of the file.

shows.description: One plain sentence on what is in the frame: who, where, doing what. Not what you wish it showed.

tags.description: Lower-case words a caption might use for it: surgery, xray, team, reception, exterior, smile, child.

patientVisible.description: True if a patient (not staff) is identifiable. Such media is not used.

focal.description: Where the faces or the subject are, so crops keep them.

traps.description: Look-alikes: what this is NOT. e.g. 'is the X-ray plate scanner, not the steriliser'.

doNotUse.description: If set, never use it; says why.

usedIn.description: Documents that already use it, so a month does not repeat photos.

origin.description: Where the original lives (for the owner's reference). Not used by the renderer.

license.description: Stock only: the licence it came under (the full record is assets/stock/licences.json).

start.description: Clips only: usable range start, seconds.

end.description: Clips only: usable range end, seconds.

speech.description: Clips only: what is said, if anything.

motion.description: Clips only: what moves (slow pan, static, handheld walk).
